FREE RENTAL PLANNING · UNITED STATES

One shortlist for an apartment search across sites.

Your best options may be scattered across property-manager websites, apartment portals, furnished-housing sites, and individual listings. A shared search tab does not tell you which home includes parking or which quote has changed. A useful shortlist keeps the original link alongside the details you have actually checked.

Start your free rental shortlist

From open tabs to a decision in five steps

  1. Add a public listing link. Copy the public page URL, not a private application or account link. Give it a name you recognize, such as “Studio near work.”
  2. Write down the quote. Enter the city, rent, utilities, recurring fees, one-time costs, and deposit when known. Leave unknown amounts blank; a blank is not a promise that the cost is zero.
  3. Record what matters to your stay. Add planned dates, bedrooms, amenities, and questions about pets, parking, furnishings, or laundry. Your dates are a plan, not confirmed availability.
  4. Swipe or use Save and Pass. Review your options, keep favorites, and undo a decision if you change your mind. Compare the saved options using the same cost categories.
  5. Return to the original listing. Confirm the current offer, ask your questions, and inquire or apply on the source site. Track your own progress in private notes.

A note format you can reuse

For each place, write: “Checked on [date]. Quote for [move-in] to [move-out]. Included: [items]. Still unknown: [questions]. Next step: [action].” Record answers after a tour or conversation instead of relying on your memory of a photo.

Can I save links from different rental platforms?

You can manually add public HTTPS rental links, including links you find on Zillow, Airbnb, Furnished Finder, Craigslist, or a property manager's own site. NestMatch does not import those platforms' listings, photos, prices, or availability. There is no partnership implied by saving a link, and NestMatch does not send messages or applications for you.

Does it work outside Pensacola?

The personal link organizer works with links from any location. Its cost fields are in U.S. dollars: compare quotes in USD and do not mix currencies. The separate live discovery feed currently covers Pensacola, Florida; saving your own links does not expand that feed.

Where are my saved rentals?

Links and notes stay in this browser profile. There is no account, cloud sync, or automatic transfer to another phone. Download a private JSON backup from the organizer before clearing browser data; use Restore backup to move your shortlist to another browser. Keep the backup private. Do not add credit reports, banking information, identity documents, or private application links.

Next: check the listing before you commit, or compare two complete rental quotes.

Current availability: guides and tools are open to everyone. NestMatch links to real source listings with initial Pensacola coverage. Availability must be confirmed on the original site; NestMatch is not a booking service.
